posts.title: MakePass CLI: Create Apple Wallet Passes from Terminal, Scripts and AI Agents
posts.description: MakePass includes a command-line interface (CLI) on Mac to create and customize Apple Wallet passes, find passes in Wallet, and export them from Terminal, scripts, or AI agents. Command-line automation requires MakePass Ultra . Get Started Open “Automate with Command Line…” in the MakePass app. This section includes the tool’s path, your Automation Token , and commands ready to copy into Terminal.
